senses.en: (fml.) affect sb. / sth. in an unpleasant way, and make them suffer
examples: I understand the burdens that [[afflict]] your family, and I pledge to you my efforts to help overcome them.

senses.zh: （威胁、攻击或警告）隐含的，不明言的
senses.en: (threat, attack, or warning) not direct but is easily understood
examples: They launched a thinly [[veiled]] attack on his ability as a leader.

senses.en: prevent from being seen or discovered
examples: Why did you decide to [[conceal]] your true identity?

senses.en: do or say sth. quickly or without delay
examples: I [[hastened]] to assure her that there was no danger of falling down from the bridge.

senses.en: vt.make sth. happen faster or sooner
examples: There are, in theory, many ways to [[hasten]] economic recovery after a financial crisis.

senses.zh: 预先阻止；在（他人）之前行动 ; 先发制人
senses.en: prevent sth. from happening or prevent sb. from doing sth. by doing sth. first
examples: My mother tells me that to [[forestall]] is better than to amend and prevention is better than cure.

senses.en: gentle and careful in a way that shows love
examples: He was a rebel, but a strong part of him was sensitive and [[tender]], just as his sister.

senses.en: (food) easily cut and eat, esp. because it has been well cooked
examples: Cook for a minimum of two hours, or until the meat is [[tender]].

senses.en: (wept, wept) cry because you feel unhappy or have some other strong emotion
examples: Wonderfully melodic and tuneful, his songs have made the audience [[weep]].

senses.en: (~ yourself to sth.) feel an emotion so strongly that you let it control you completely
examples: We are scared to [[abandon]] ourselves to our feelings in case we seem weak or out of control.

senses.en: leave sb. when you should stay with them and look after them
examples: He can never forgive his mother because she [[abandoned]] him when he was five years old.

senses.en: a complete surrender of inhibitions
examples: In some poetry, sensitivity, she suggests, "has led to a dangerous [[abandonment]] to sensation."

senses.en: a feeling of being extremely tired and without energy
examples: Weak with [[exhaustion]], the climbers were finally rescued by a helicopter after being trapped in heavy snow.

senses.en: continue to cause problems for a person or organization for a long time
examples: The shame of being a bankrupt is likely to [[haunt]] Mr. Lucas for the rest of his life.

senses.en: if the soul of a dead person haunts a place, it appears there often
examples: They say the prison is [[haunted]] by the ghosts of the men who died there.

senses.zh: （一般不在商店内出售的）商品，货物
senses.en: things that are for sale, usu. not in a shop
examples: The major off-line brands aren't promoting their [[wares]] on the Internet as much as expected.

senses.en: in a way that is difficult to see, hear, smell, etc.
examples: When the piano fell silent, the sound of the traffic echoed [[faintly]] in the room.

senses.en: (of birds) make a lot of short high sounds

senses.zh: （与周围部分不同的）小片，小块
senses.en: a small area of sth. that is different from the area around it
examples: Belinda watched a [[patch]] of sunlight move slowly across the wall.

senses.en: an act or sound of sobbing
vi.cry noisily while taking short breaths
examples: After a while, she began to [[sob]] again, burying her face in the pillow.

senses.en: (bespoke, bespoken) show or suggest sth.
examples: Her house, her clothes, her style of living, all [[bespeak]] an exceedingly good income.

senses.en: stop yourself from doing sth. you want to do
examples: She could not [[repress]] a smile at this, but she answered only by nodding her head slightly.

senses.en: the behavior of sb. who refuses to show or admit strong feelings that they have
examples: He told her that emotional [[repression]] was preventing her from understanding her own behavior.

senses.en: a long steady look
examples: She felt embarrassed under his steady [[gaze]].

senses.en: over there
examples: Now look [[yonder]], just beyond the wooden post — there's a white cottage under the hill.

senses.en: when sth. is officially stopped for a period of time
examples: Anyway, we have to admit that both sides are now working toward a [[suspension]] of hostility.

senses.zh: 细微的；微妙的；难以察觉的
senses.en: not obvious, and therefore difficult to notice
examples: I sensed a [[subtle]] change in his attitude toward us.

senses.en: difficult to find or not often seen
examples: Who can tell me how to catch the [[elusive]] charm of the original version in translation?

senses.en: (crept, crept) move slowly and quietly
examples: When cats are preparing to pounce on (猛扑) the mouse, they [[creep]] over the ground very slowly.

senses.en: a particular smell, esp. a pleasant one
examples: Flowers are chosen by customers for their [[scent]] as well as their look.

senses.zh: 骚乱地；骚动地；混乱地；激动地
senses.en: in a way that involves a lot of noise, excitement, activity, or violence
examples: They gathered [[tumultuously]] around him and demanded to know how he had accomplished it.

senses.en: tall or long and thin in an attractive way
examples: The dress is for my daughter who's about my height but more [[slender]].

senses.en: looking as if you do not understand or are not paying attention
examples: The maid's [[vacant]] expression was replaced momentarily by one of greedy expectation, shortly followed by disappointment.

senses.en: (seat, room, etc.) empty and available for sb. to use
examples: All three sets of houses are [[vacant]], and she's making no attempt to rent them out.

senses.en: a feeling of extreme fear
examples: She shook with [[terror]] whenever she was about to fly in a plane by herself.

senses.en: the regular movement of blood as the heart pumps it round the body
examples: The doctor said he was in danger — his breathing was shallow and his [[pulse]] was weak.

senses.zh: 极端错误的；道德败坏的；极不公正的
senses.en: very wrong, immoral, or unfair
examples: I'd like to make a complaint — it's [[monstrous]] to charge that much for a hotel room.

senses.zh: 兴高采烈的；得意洋洋的
senses.en: extremely happy and proud
examples: We were absolutely [[exalted]] when we learned of your daughter's career success.

senses.en: having a very high rank; highly respected
examples: Leith doubted that she would ever meet a man in such a highly [[exalted]] position.

senses.en: refuse to consider sb.'s idea, opinion, etc. because you think it is not serious, true or important
examples: The government has [[dismissed]] criticism that the country's health policy is a mess.

senses.en: a series of people or things
examples: We've had an endless [[procession]] of new secretaries in the office since Amy left.

senses.en: determination to do sth. even though it is difficult or other people oppose it
examples: The teacher kept saying that skill comes only with practice, patience and [[persistence]].

senses.en: (fml.) a clear explanation or understanding of a particular subject
examples: In that flash of [[illumination]], he realized where he had gone wrong in his decision-making.

senses.en: lighting provided by a lamp, light, etc.
examples: The only [[illumination]] came from a small window high in the opposite wall.

senses.en: (knelt, knelt; kneeled, kneeled) be in or move into a position where your body is resting on your knees
examples: She [[knelt]] on the floor and put more wood on the fire so that the room would be warmer.

senses.en: a magical liquid that is supposed to cure people of illness, make them younger, etc.
examples: You fool, it's yet another health product claiming to be the [[elixir]] of youth.

senses.en: a violent protest by a crowd of people
examples: The police were able to take preventive action and avoid a possible [[riot]].

senses.en: a quick uncontrolled shaking movement
examples: As she turned away from the house into the lane, she gave a [[shudder]] of relief.

senses.en: the act of asking sb. for sth. continuously in an annoying or unreasonable way
examples: Unable to withstand my [[importunity]], he would make out drafts for me to copy.

senses.zh: 特别激动的；极度兴奋的
senses.en: extremely excited
examples: He will be attending next week's Grammy Awards in [[feverish]] anticipation.

senses.en: suffering from a fever
examples: You ought to be careful about this kind of [[feverish]] cold — it often kicks back.

senses.zh: 成功的满足感；胜利的喜悦之情
senses.en: the proud or excited feeling you get when you have won sth. or been successful
examples: My father returned in [[triumph]] from the annual sales of the department store with a half-price TV.

senses.en: an important victory or success after a difficult struggle
examples: If confirmed by longer and larger clinical trials, this will rightly be hailed as a scientific [[triumph]].

senses.en: in a way that is not conscious or deliberate
examples: Many parents [[unwittingly]] place their children in danger by not making sure they wear seat belts.

senses.en: hold sb. / sth. tightly with your hands
examples: She would often [[clasp]] her hands behind her head and muse when she could have a house of her own.

senses.en: (fml.) move from a higher level to a lower one
examples: I heard his footsteps [[descending]] the stairs — he must have finished his work.

senses.zh: （房子或公寓大门的）碰锁钥匙

senses.en: in a way that seems calm and in control of your feelings
examples: It is difficult to think [[composedly]] when you are being attacked by mosquitoes.

senses.en: make a small hole in or through sth., using an object with a sharp point
examples: The chef taught him to steam the corn until it can easily be [[pierced]] with a fork.

senses.en: (sound) high, sharp and unpleasant
examples: Maggie let out a [[piercing]] scream as she saw the truck speeding toward her.

senses.en: sb. with piercing eyes is looking at you and seems to know what you are thinking
examples: Cloudy and unfocused for a moment, his eyes quickly regained their normal [[piercing]] clarity.

senses.en: make the effort to do sth.
examples: There is an old saying: "Take the time to stop and smell the flowers."

senses.en: be important or valuable
examples: When I first came to college, I realized that brainpower didn't [[count]] for much.

senses.en: (spoken) used when sb. is telling sb. else how important it is to do sth. or not to do sth.
examples: For heaven's sake, don't be late. Otherwise, we won't be able to catch the plane.

senses.zh: 享受地看（听，感觉，嗅）；品味；欣赏
senses.en: look at, listen to, feel, or smell sth. in order to enjoy it
examples: She just sat there, [[drinking]] in the stunning view of the sunset.

senses.zh: （想象力）自由驰骋；（情感、思绪等）不受约束
senses.en: (imagination, emotions, thoughts, etc.) go out of control
examples: They have let their imagination [[run]] riot to create new computer games.

senses.en: after a long time
examples: At length she became uneasy, and woke up the boy and asked, "Do you know where your dad is?"

senses.zh: 布伦特利 • 马拉德（人名）
